_about: The level tiers. Edit by hand, or: node scripts/tiers.mjs move <id> <tier> [position]. Tiers 1-5 are the gold-star tiers, 6-10 the Blue Star ones (Blue 1 is tier 6). A level appears once: in one tier, in events, or in outside. The events are in events.json. Outside levels open in the order listed here (the first once tier 10 is cleared); an amphibious level opens by the rule in tiers.js amphibiousOpens; races are always open.
